name: Goalverse
summary: Goalverse is an immersive VR soccer game that transports players into a high-energy, futuristic world of competitive football. Designed for full-body interaction, players can run, kick, dive, and block using natural movements, delivering a physically engaging and adrenaline-pumping experience.
